scope: East & Southeast Texas (Smith, Gregg, Angelina, Nacogdoches, Jefferson counties; Tyler, Longview, Lufkin, Beaumont, Port Arthur)

records.name: East Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: Regional food bank that supplies food pantries, produce distributions and other feeding programs across East Texas. Its online Find Food tool shows the pantry nearest you.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in the food bank's East Texas service area who needs food can use the Find Food tool to locate help.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the Find Food page and enter your address, city or ZIP code to see pantries and food distributions near you, or call the food bank.
records.notes: Serves 26-27 East Texas counties including Smith, Gregg, Angelina and Nacogdoches. Runs resource centers in Tyler, Longview, Lufkin and Texarkana.

records.name: Tyler Resource Center (Food Pantry and Benefits Help)
records.description_en: Client food pantry with shelf-stable food, meat and fresh produce. Staff also help you apply for SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, CHIP and other programs, and offer utility assistance and nutrition classes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households at or below the TEFAP (The Emergency Food Assistance Program) income guidelines, plus people going through a crisis. All are welcome regardless of where they live. You may visit the pantry twice a month.
documents_needed: No papers required: you verbally share name, address, household size, date of birth and monthly income
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during pantry hours and tell staff your name, address, household size, date of birth and monthly income. Benefits application help is by appointment.
records.notes: Pantry use limited to twice per month. Benefits Assistance is by appointment.

records.name: Longview Resource Center (Food Pantry and Benefits Help)
records.description_en: Food pantry with shelf-stable food, meat and fresh produce. Staff also help with SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, CHIP and Medicare applications, utility assistance and referrals.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All are welcome. Serves households at or below TEFAP income guidelines and people in crisis. You may visit the pantry twice a month.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours. The center is on Longview Transit Route 1.
records.notes: Reachable by Longview Transit Route 1. Pantry visits limited to twice monthly.

records.name: Deep East Texas Resource Center (Lufkin Food Pantry and Benefits Help)
records.description_en: Food pantry plus help applying for SNAP, Medicaid and other benefits. Also offers utility assistance and nutrition education.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Welcomes all community members regardless of where they live. You may visit the pantry twice a month.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours or call the center.
records.notes: Located in Lufkin; the page says it welcomes all regardless of where they live, so Nacogdoches residents can also use it.

records.name: Southeast Texas Food Bank
records.description_en: Regional food bank for Southeast Texas. It helps you find the nearest food pantry or other emergency food source in your county.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of its 8-county service area, which includes Jefferson County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the food bank or use the Get Help section of its website, which lists partner agencies by county.
records.notes: Toll free (844) 356-9084. Serves Hardin, Jasper, Jefferson, Newton, Orange, Polk, Sabine and Tyler counties.

records.name: Market to HOPE Food Pantry
records.description_en: Client-choice food pantry where you shop for groceries including fresh produce, protein and dairy. Open six days a week with evening hours for working families.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-to-moderate income households facing food insecurity, and people with a temporary hardship. Open to all regardless of religion.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Beaumont location or call the program to learn how to sign up.
records.hours: Open six days a week, including evening hours (call for exact times)
records.notes: Shopping help is available for people with physical disabilities. A second location is in Winnie (902 E. 3rd Street). Main Catholic Charities line: (409) 924-4400.

records.name: Hospitality Center Daily Hot Meal
records.description_en: Serves a free, freshly made hot meal every day of the year in Port Arthur.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in need, including seniors on fixed incomes, working people, people with disabilities and people experiencing homelessness.
records.how_to_apply: Just come to the Hospitality Center at meal time. No application is described.
records.hours: Open 7 days a week, 365 days a year (call for meal time)

records.name: Energy Assistance (CEAP) - Smith County
records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills through the state Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP), with case management and energy education.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households. Priority goes to households with high energy use, children age 5 or younger, seniors, and people with disabilities.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online by scheduling an appointment, download a paper application (English or Spanish), or call your county office. Text 936-553-0318 to check application status.
records.notes: Processing can take 60-90 days after all documents are received; keep paying your bills while you wait. TDHCA's provider lookup lists GETCAP as the CEAP provider for this county (toll free (800) 621-5746). Income limits were not stated on the page.

records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills through the state Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP), with case management and energy education.

records.notes: Processing can take 60-90 days after all documents are received; keep paying your bills while you wait. TDHCA's provider lookup lists GETCAP as the CEAP provider for this county (toll free (800) 621-5746). Income limits were not stated on the page.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program
records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Makes homes more energy efficient to help lower utility bills.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in GETCAP's service area. Exact income limits were not stated on the page.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the GETCAP energy assistance office for your county; weatherization is offered at the same offices.
records.notes: County offices: Tyler (903) 962-2670; Longview (903) 758-5674; Lufkin (936) 899-7238; Beaumont (409) 247-6270.

records.name: Head Start and Early Head Start
records.organization: Greater East Texas Community Action Program (GETCAP)
records.description_en: Free early learning program for young children from income-eligible families, with centers in Tyler and Nacogdoches.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Young children and families who meet Head Start income rules (details not stated on the page).
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Head Start center in your county to ask about enrollment.
records.notes: Nacogdoches center: 1902 Old Tyler Road, Nacogdoches, TX 75964, (936) 564-1142.

records.name: Home Matters (Rent, Utility and Food Assistance)
records.description_en: Helps pay rent, utilities and food for people facing a temporary hardship. Also offers rental housing counseling, money skills coaching and free tax preparation.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in the nine-county Southeast Texas service area (including Jefferson County) facing a temporary hardship. Open to all regardless of religion.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Client Service Representative to discuss your situation and learn which documents you need.
records.notes: Counseling services are offered in English and Spanish. Counselors can explain tenant rights and the eviction process.

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) - City of Tyler
records.description_en: Helps very low-income families, seniors and people with disabilities pay rent for safe housing. The city also runs first-time homebuyer and home repair programs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Very low-income families, elderly and disabled people. The waiting list is currently closed.
records.how_to_apply: The voucher waiting list is closed. Check your existing application status at assistancecheck.com or waitlistcheck.com, or contact Neighborhood Services.
records.notes: Waitlist CLOSED as of this check (random selection from applications submitted by June 26, 2025 completed). TDHCA also lists Tyler Housing Authority at the same number.

records.name: Beaumont Housing Authority
records.description_en: Provides public housing and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8), plus Family Self-Sufficiency, homeownership help and services for elderly and disabled residents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households who meet the housing authority's income limits and eligibility rules (posted on its website).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the authority's RentCafe portal when waiting lists are open, or call the office.
records.notes: Waitlist status was not shown on the page; call to confirm. TDHCA lists (409) 951-7207.

records.name: Port Arthur Housing Authority
records.description_en: Public agency that provides subsidized housing, including Housing Choice Vouchers, VASH vouchers for veterans, Foster Youth to Independence and a homeownership program.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low and moderate income individuals and families. The Housing Choice Voucher waitlist is currently closed.
records.how_to_apply: The voucher waitlist is closed and not accepting applications. Call the office to ask about other programs.
records.notes: Housing Choice Voucher waitlist CLOSED at time of check. Reasonable accommodation requests: (409) 984-2632. Relay Texas: 1-800-735-2989.

records.name: Deep East Texas Regional Housing Authority - Housing Choice Voucher
records.organization: Deep East Texas Council of Governments (DETCOG)
records.description_en: Runs a Housing Choice Voucher program that helps about 1,800 households in Deep East Texas pay rent, plus VASH vouchers for homeless veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Eligible low-income residents of Deep East Texas; details on eligibility and waitlist are on dethousing.org.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the housing authority, or visit dethousing.org for application and waitlist details.
records.notes: Email housing@detcog.gov. TDHCA lists this authority for Angelina County; Nacogdoches County has its own housing authority.

records.name: Nacogdoches Housing Authority
records.description_en: Local public housing authority listed by the state for rent payment help in Nacogdoches County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income Nacogdoches County residents; contact the authority for current rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call the housing authority to ask about openings and how to apply.
records.notes: Confirmed via TDHCA's Help for Texans provider directory only (TDHCA says listings are self-reported). Address and waitlist status not confirmed.

records.name: Longview Housing Assistance Program
records.description_en: Local program listed by the state for long-term rent payment help in Longview. The City of Longview Housing and Community Development department is also listed for emergency help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income Longview/Gregg County residents; contact the program for rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call the program to ask about openings and how to apply.
records.notes: Confirmed via TDHCA's Help for Texans directory only. City of Longview Department of Housing and Community Development: (903) 237-1241.

records.name: City of Beaumont Community Development
records.description_en: City department listed by the state as a source of emergency and rent payment help for Beaumont residents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Beaumont residents with low income; contact the department for current programs and rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call the department to ask what help is currently available.
records.notes: Confirmed via TDHCA's Help for Texans directory only. City of Port Arthur Housing Department is also listed: (409) 983-8259.

records.name: Hiway 80 Rescue Mission
records.description_en: Emergency shelter, meals, showers, clothing, case management and recovery programs for people who are homeless or in crisis. Also offers a day resource center and long-term transitional living.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Men, women and children experiencing homelessness, crisis, addiction, abuse or poverty.
records.how_to_apply: Call or go to the mission to ask about shelter and services.
records.notes: Christian ministry. Programs include Gateway to Hope day resource center and Triumph Village transitional living. Hours not listed.

records.name: The Salvation Army of Tyler
records.description_en: Local Salvation Army that offers shelter and other help to people in need in Tyler.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in need in the Tyler area; call for current services and rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Tyler Corps to ask about shelter and assistance.
records.notes: The page lists shelter as an area of focus but does not detail specific programs or hours; call first.

records.name: The Salvation Army of Lufkin
records.description_en: Local Salvation Army offering food assistance and community services. Veterans can ask about help with utilities and rent.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in need in the Lufkin area. Utility and rent help mentioned on the page is for veterans.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Lufkin office.
records.notes: Veteran utility/rent help is supported by the Texas Veterans Commission. Family Store: 205 E. Jodie Ave, (936) 634-7212.

records.name: Tyler Transit (Bus, ParaTransit and MicroTransit)
records.description_en: City bus service with half-price fares for seniors, Medicare holders and people with disabilities. Also offers ParaTransit shared rides and on-demand MicroTransit.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Reduced $0.50 fare for seniors 65+, Medicare card holders and people with disabilities with proof of eligibility.
documents_needed: Proof of age, Medicare card or disability (for reduced fare)
records.how_to_apply: Pay on the bus or buy passes online through Token Transit or at the Transit Depot. Bring proof of eligibility for reduced fare.
records.cost: Adult $1.00; seniors/Medicare/disabled $0.50; children 6-11 $0.50; 5 and under free; all-day pass $2
records.notes: Transit Depot office sells passes. 30-day pass $40, 7-day $10.

records.name: Longview Transit (Bus and Paratransit)
records.description_en: City bus service with reduced fares for seniors, Medicare holders and people with disabilities, plus ADA paratransit rides for people who cannot use the bus.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Reduced $0.60 fare for people 60+, Medicare holders or people with a documented disability who get an MSD pass. Paratransit is for people whose disability keeps them from using fixed-route buses.
records.how_to_apply: For reduced fare, bring a picture ID to the Transit Administration Office to get an MSD pass (photo taken in person). For paratransit, fill out an application verified by a licensed health provider; decisions take up to 21 days.
records.cost: Regular $1.25; seniors/Medicare/disabled $0.60; children 6-14 $0.65; day pass $3; paratransit $2.50 per trip
records.notes: Paratransit hours Mon-Fri 6 a.m.-7 p.m., Sat 7 a.m.-7 p.m.; book up to 14 days ahead at (903) 753-2287 ext. 10. TTY (903) 753-5265.

records.name: Beaumont Municipal Transit (ZIP)
records.description_en: City bus service with reduced fares for seniors, youth and people with disabilities, free rides for veterans, and paratransit vans for ADA-eligible riders.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Seniors 65+ with Medicare card and disabled riders with a Beaumont ID pay $0.75. Veterans ride free with a Veterans Pass application.
records.how_to_apply: Pay exact fare on the bus or buy passes at 550 Milam Street or Central Collections at City Hall (801 Main Street).
records.cost: Adult $1.50; youth/senior/disabled $0.75; veterans free; paratransit $2.50 per ride or $80 monthly
records.notes: Drivers do not carry change. K-12 students ride free in summer. A Student Mobility Pass is available.

records.name: GoBus Rural Transit
records.description_en: Demand-response public transportation for rural East Texas, including rides to appointments. Free rides for veterans and active military, including trips to the Overton Brooks VA in Shreveport.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the general public in the non-urbanized (rural) parts of Smith and Gregg counties and 12 other East Texas counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-800-590-3371 to book your trip ahead of time, or request a trip online.
records.cost: $2 per trip, $1 per additional stop; free for veterans and active military
records.notes: Serves only non-urbanized areas of Smith and Gregg; inside Tyler and Longview use city transit.

records.name: Brazos Transit District - Lufkin and Nacogdoches
records.description_en: Fixed-route buses, ADA paratransit and demand-response rides in Lufkin and Nacogdoches.
records.eligibility_summary_en: General public; ADA paratransit is for eligible people with disabilities.
records.how_to_apply: New riders call the Dispatch Center to book paratransit or demand-response trips; existing customers can book online at portal.btd.org.
records.cost: Fares vary; cash and major credit cards accepted
records.notes: Dispatch also (979) 778-4480. Customer service (979) 778-0607 ext 7008. DETCOG refers Deep East Texas residents to BTD for public transit. Fare amounts not confirmed.

records.name: South East Texas Transit (SETT)
records.organization: South East Texas Regional Planning Commission
records.description_en: Demand-response rides in rural western Jefferson County, and rides for seniors and people with disabilities in Groves, Port Neches and Nederland.
records.eligibility_summary_en: General public in rural western Jefferson County; seniors 65+ and people with disabilities in Mid-Jefferson County cities.
records.how_to_apply: Call ahead to schedule; advance notice is required.
records.cost: See service brochure; fares vary by area
records.notes: Mid-County and Rural Jefferson scheduling: (800) 259-4457 or (409) 892-0979. Medicare-eligible clients may qualify for more options through 2-1-1.

records.name: Workforce Solutions East Texas
records.description_en: Free job search help, career counseling, training and scholarships, and help with unemployment benefits, with centers in Tyler and Longview.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and employers in 14 East Texas counties, including Smith and Gregg.
records.how_to_apply: Call the regional line or visit a workforce center. Search jobs on WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Phone is 1-844-ETWORKS. Workforce centers in Tyler and Longview (street addresses not confirmed this session). Special help for veterans, young adults and students with disabilities.

records.name: Child Care Services - Workforce Solutions East Texas
records.description_en: Helps eligible families pay for child care so parents can work, go to school or train.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Eligible low-income families in the 14-county East Texas workforce area, including Smith and Gregg. Income limits were not stated on the page.
records.how_to_apply: Call Workforce Solutions East Texas to ask about applying for child care financial aid.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas - Angelina County (Lufkin)
records.description_en: Free career planning, job matching, resume and interview help, and access to training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in Angelina County and the surrounding Deep East Texas area.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center during business hours or call.
records.notes: Relay Texas: 7-1-1.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas - Nacogdoches County
records.description_en: Free career planning, job matching, resume and interview help, and access to training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in Nacogdoches County and the surrounding area.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center during business hours or call.

records.name: Child Care Services - Workforce Solutions Deep East Texas
records.description_en: Temporary financial aid to help eligible families pay for child care. Families pay a co-payment based on income and household size.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Eligible families in Angelina, Houston, Jasper, Nacogdoches, Polk and Shelby counties. Income limits were not stated on the page.
records.how_to_apply: See the Parents page on detwork.org or contact your local workforce center.
records.cost: Co-payment based on income and household size
records.notes: Local centers: Lufkin (936) 639-1351; Nacogdoches (936) 560-1441.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Southeast Texas
records.description_en: Free job search and placement, skills training, youth programs (ages 16-24), veteran services, and child care services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and families in Jefferson, Orange and Hardin counties.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Beaumont or Port Arthur workforce center, or call the main line.
records.notes: Main line (877) 834-5627. Port Arthur center: 4680 FM 365, (409) 962-1236. Child care services use a separate portal on the website.

records.name: Andrews Behavioral Health (Andrews Center)
records.description_en: Local mental health authority offering crisis services, adult and youth mental health care, substance use treatment, IDD and autism services, and veteran services. Runs a Diversion Center in Tyler for crisis stabilization.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of Henderson, Rains, Smith, Van Zandt and Wood counties, especially people who are underserved.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Tyler clinic to request services. In a crisis call the 24/7 hotline or 988.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (877) 934-2131. Diversion Center: 3111 North Northwest Loop 323, Tyler, TX 75702. Fee details not stated on the page.

records.name: Community Healthcore
records.description_en: Certified community behavioral health clinic offering mental health, substance use, crisis, IDD, primary care, veteran and supportive housing services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children, teens, adults and veterans in its service area, including Gregg County. Sliding fee based on income; accepts Medicaid and Medicare.
records.how_to_apply: Call the services line for referrals or visit a Longview location.
records.cost: Sliding scale by income; Medicaid, Medicare and many insurance plans accepted
records.notes: 24/7 crisis line: (800) 832-1009. Adult mental health and primary care: 1300 North Sixth Street, Longview, (903) 297-1852. Substance use and crisis: 950 North Fourth Street, (903) 758-0596. Also has a Tyler location.

records.name: Burke (Mental Health and IDD Services)
records.description_en: Local mental health and developmental disability provider offering adult and child mental health care, substance use services, IDD services, early childhood intervention (birth to 3) and veteran support.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of Burke's 11-county area, which includes Angelina and Nacogdoches counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call the mental health services line to request services. In a crisis call the 24-hour hotline.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: 1-800-392-8343. Toll free services line (866) 242-4556. Early Childhood Intervention: (936) 634-4703. Central administration: (936) 639-1141.

records.name: Spindletop Center
records.description_en: Behavioral health center in Beaumont offering mental health care, substance use recovery, IDD services, early childhood intervention and crisis services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People needing behavioral health care in the Beaumont area. No one is turned away for inability to pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to ask about services. In a crisis call the 24-hour hotline.
records.cost: Sliding fee scale based on family size and income; no one turned away for inability to pay
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: 1-800-937-8097. Toll free: 1-800-317-5809. The page did not list its full county service area.

records.name: Wellness Pointe
records.description_en: Community health clinics offering family medicine, pediatrics, women's health, dental, vision and behavioral health, plus parenting and family programs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Patients in Northeast Texas, with clinics in Longview and a women's health center in Tyler.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to make an appointment.
records.notes: Toll free (888) 811-6648. Tyler Women's Health Center: 825 Medical Drive. Other Longview clinics: 425 N Fredonia St, 2131 Mobberly Ave, 1761 W Loop 281, 802 Medical Circle. Sliding fee not confirmed on page.

records.name: Lone Star Legal Aid - East and Southeast Texas Offices
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income Texans, including eviction defense, family law, public benefits, consumer, employment and domestic violence cases.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income people who meet financial and legal status rules. Civil cases only, no criminal cases.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online any time or call the toll-free intake line.
records.notes: Beaumont office serves Jefferson; Longview office serves Gregg; Tyler office serves Smith; Nacogdoches office serves Angelina and Nacogdoches. Exact income limit not stated on the site. Statewide eviction help also at texaslawhelp.org/eviction-referral or (855) 270-7655.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of East Texas
records.description_en: Senior nutrition (meals), benefits counseling, care coordination, caregiver support and ombudsman help for older adults.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People age 60 and older, people with disabilities and caregivers in 14 East Texas counties, including Smith and Gregg.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Area Agency on Aging to ask for services.
records.notes: Main office 3800 Stone Road, Kilgore; local (903) 218-6500. Website: www.EastTexasAAA.org.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of Deep East Texas
records.organization: Deep East Texas Council of Governments (DETCOG)
records.description_en: Congregate and home-delivered meals, benefits counseling for Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security, caregiver support, care coordination and ombudsman help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People age 60 and older in Deep East Texas; the Aging and Disability Resource Center serves people of any age with disabilities.
records.how_to_apply: Call the agency to request services.
records.notes: Also (409) 384-7614. More info at www.aaadeepeasttx.org. DETCOG region includes Angelina and Nacogdoches counties.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging - Southeast Texas
records.organization: South East Texas Regional Planning Commission
records.description_en: Senior meals (group and home-delivered), senior transportation, benefits counseling, care coordination, caregiver support and ombudsman services.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Older adults in Hardin, Jefferson and Orange counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Area Agency on Aging to ask for services.
